sensors.guide: Angular lint must pass; fix the code rather than the rule.
The app must typecheck before the turn ends.
Run the component and service specs before claiming done; fix the code, never the specs.

sensors.cmd: if [ -f .rig/gen/dependency-cruiser.cjs ]; then npx --no-install depcruise src --config .rig/gen/dependency-cruiser.cjs --ignore-known .rig/gen/known-violations.json --output-type err; else echo 'layers: not enforced here (no approved layers config)'; fi
sensors.guide: Respect the approved layers in architecture.md; do not import across a forbidden boundary.

sensors.cmd: d=$(mktemp -d) && npx --yes jscpd@5.4.2 src --silent --reporters json --output "$d" >&2 && node -p "try{require('$d/jscpd-report.json').statistics.total.percentage}catch{0}"
sensors.guide: Reuse existing components and services instead of copying them; the duplicated share may not grow past its baseline.
Do not add dependencies with known high-severity vulnerabilities.

sensors.cmd: [ -x node_modules/.bin/stryker ] || { echo 'mutation-diff: Stryker is not installed: npm i -D @stryker-mutator/core, or the person waives mutation-diff'; exit 1; }; rm -rf reports/mutation; npx --no-install stryker run --mutate {changed-lines:js,jsx,ts,tsx,mjs,cjs,mts,cts} --reporters json --logLevel warn >&2 && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const f='reports/mutation/mutation.json';const r=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'));fs.rmSync('reports/mutation',{recursive:true,force:true});try{fs.rmdirSync('reports')}catch{}const s=[];for(const[p,v]of Object.entries(r.files))for(const m of v.mutants)if(m.status==='Survived'||m.status==='NoCoverage')s.push(p+':'+m.location.start.line+' '+m.status+': '+m.mutatorName+(m.replacement?' -> '+JSON.stringify(m.replacement):''));console.log(s.length?s.length+' mutant(s) on changed lines survive the tests:\n'+s.join('\n'):'every mutant on changed lines is killed');process.exit(s.length?1:0)"
sensors.guide: Every line this change adds is pinned by a test: a surviving mutant names a line and a change no test noticed; strengthen the test, or delete the dead code.
Specs must assert behaviour so that changing the code makes them fail.
